title: 22 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj receives diksha
story: Shantilal receives parshad diksha in Ahmedabad and becomes Shanti Bhagat. After renouncing Chansad on 7 November 1939, Shantilal met Shastriji Maharaj in Ahmedabad on 21 November 1939. Shastriji Maharaj blessed Shantilal and expressed his wish, “In the morning, I want to initiate you as a parshad.”
story_short: On this day in 1939, in Ahmedabad, Shastriji Maharaj gave parshad diksha to Shantilal, who became Shanti Bhagat, later Pramukh Swami Maharaj.

options.headline: Prabodhini Ekadashi 2004 in Sarangpur
options.story:
At 7.10 pm Swamishri performed the shakotsav arti of Thakorji. A variety of fresh vegetable had been displayed before the deities. During the evening satsang assembly Swamishri underlined the meaning of true living.

K.K. Shastri and Devkinandan Dwivedi light the traditional lamp to inaugurate the Golden Anniversary conference of the Akhil Bharatiya Darshan Parishad at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Amdavad. Performs arti of Shakotsav. Blesses the satsang assembly. On stage during the inaugural session. During the inauguration of Hiramani Chhatralay (school hostel) and then blesses the assembly. Performs the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandirs (sanskardhams) for Memnagar and Odhav suburbs. At the Ambli Vali Pol. Departs from Ambli Vali Pol. Arrives for darshan at the historic Ambli Vali Pol. In a jovial mood during an assembly. K.K. Shastri and Devkinandan Dwivedi light the traditional lamp to inaugurate the Golden Anniversary conference of the Akhil Bharatiya Darshan Parishad at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Amdavad. Variety of fresh vegetables offered to Thakorji on Kartak sud Ekadashi (Shakotsav). Balaks with Bapa after their performance.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj performs the murti pratishtha at the newly constructed Swaminarayan Mandir in Nehrul, New Mumbai
options.story:
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha at the newly constructed Swaminarayan Mandir in Nehrul, New Mumbai.

In the evening Swamishri travelled to Sahara Lake City, about 120 kms from Mumbai .

Inviting the Lord in his puja. Performs murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj. Bapa and sadhus sing thaal Humble respects to the Lord during morning puja. Performs the arti. Sings the Swaminarayan dhun. Writes the Swaminarayan maha-mantra. Sings thaal before Lord Harikrishna. Applies tilak and chandlo. Discourses to the sadhus. Thaal before the Lord. Humble respects to the Lord during morning puja. Meditates during puja. Gives darshan to Lord Harikrishna. Darshan of Bapa's puja. In the beautiful, idyllic surroundings of Sahara Lake City Bapa performed his morning puja.
options.whatsapp: On this day in 2000, Inviting the Lord in his puja.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj performs the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir for women
options.story:
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir for women. The previous day, a yagna was performed and a procession of the murtis was carried out in the town. More than 4,000 devotees and well wishers participated.

Performs the arti at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Vaso. Performs the murti-pratishtha rituals at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir for ladies, Vaso. Descends the mandir steps. Blesses the assembly. Bapa and senior sadhus on the stage during the assembly. Honored with a garland. Sadhus and bhaktas perform the arti. Performs the arti. Bhaktas doing darshan of the arti. Bhaktas during the assembly. BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Bochasan. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Aksharbrahma Gunatitanand Swami. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Lakshmi Narayan Dev. Bhaktas during the asembly.
